verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Codex Plugins is a CLI/UI-driven plugin and skills ecosystem (installers, marketplace, skill creation) but contains no evidence of a documented API/SDK that exposes plugin install, marketplace management, skill creation/invocation, or authentication flows programmatically — the openapi probe explicitly returned 404 for all candidate spec paths. missing for 10: any documented REST/SDK API surface for plugin/skill management, API parity confirmation for auth flows, and evidence of programmatic equivalents to `/plugins`, `/skills`, or marketplace commands.
